items.title: Celsius Holdings earnings analysis: questions answered and next catalysts
items.summary: Investing.com -- Celsius Holdings Inc (CELH) beat on both lines, yet the stock gave back its premarket pop. Shares were $30.02 (-2.39%) as of Nov 5, 1:24 PM EST. They had opened at $32.84 and traded as high as $33.69. Premarket had been up roughly 5–10%. The market is separating "beat" from "fixed."

items.title: Energy-Drinks Are Exploding. Why Is Celsius Stock Fizzling?
items.summary: The energy-drink industry is growing sales at 15% a year, the fastest in the beverage aisle. But competition is fierce, with each brand staking a claim to niche consumers.
